Usage: protonvpn config set [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Change a specific setting.

Options:
  -h, --help  Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  anonymous-crash-reports  Enable or disable anonymous crash reports.
  custom-dns               Configure custom DNS servers.
  ipv6                     Enable or disable IPv6 support.
  kill-switch              Configure Kill Switch to block internet if VPN...
  moderate-nat             Enable or disable Moderate NAT for improved...
  netshield                Configure NetShield ad-blocking and malware...
  port-forwarding          Enable or disable port forwarding for P2P...
  vpn-accelerator          Enable or disable VPN Accelerator for improved...
